notes: UbiSec venue is Changsha, not the publisher location Singapore. Conference held December 2024; revised proceedings published May 2025.
PerCom 2022 changed to a fully virtual event; Pisa is retained only as the host city.
Springer is a publisher mark, not an invented UbiSec venue logo. IEEE/ACM/Elsevier marks likewise identify publishers.
Journals and preprints do not receive a conference location.
Known conference and workshop dates are kept distinct using date_scope.
The author confirmed virtual attendance at UbiSec 2024 and ICASSP 2022. Other new paper milestones do not assert attendance or presentation.

Timeline date audit: all 13 conference/workshop paper and presentation milestones have day-level dates; workshop dates are used for workshop entries. FM-Wild uses 26 July 2024 from the organizer schedule; the OpenReview group header lists 27 July and was not used.
